title: C: "keep loaded always" option (keep_alive -1), off by default
goal: C: "keep loaded always" option (keep_alive -1), off by default
acceptance: Owner decision 2026-11-26 in chat: "ollama a+b, c as option in dashboard".
A setting keepLoadedAlways (default false) makes the keep-alive value -1; the validated settings API accepts only a boolean; tests cover default off, on, and that it overrides the duration
Image runs: when an image run unloads Ollama models (the runner flag --unload-ollama, owned outside this repository: T06 finds where) NERV does not reload them straight away while the run is active
privacy: Local Ollama only; test data is neutral and invented; no secrets; warm-up calls carry no user text.
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed from the existing engine-provider, config and dashboard code; bounded edit plus tests. Not a measurement.
